source: Agencia Tributaria - SII (Suministro Inmediato de Informacion) and VERI*FACTU record-supply web-service schemas
why_bundled: These schemas are the AUTHORITY for what a SII or VERI*FACTU record contains. The reader derives its mandatory-element set from them mechanically rather than from a hand-copied list, so they must ship with the package: a hand-maintained list would rot silently on the first AEAT schema revision, while a derived one cannot drift from its own source.
layout_is_load_bearing: Each family lives in its OWN directory and each file keeps its ORIGINAL AEAT filename. Both are required, for two independent reasons. (1) Every envelope declares <import schemaLocation="SuministroInformacion.xsd"/> as a RELATIVE path, so renaming the imported file breaks the import and the envelope will not compile -- 11 of the 18 schemas in the acquisition corpus fail to compile for exactly this reason, because that corpus flattened them under prefixed names. (2) SII and VERI*FACTU BOTH import a file literally named SuministroInformacion.xsd, and they are DIFFERENT schemas in DIFFERENT target namespaces; a single flat directory would silently resolve one family's import against the other family's types. Do not flatten, do not rename.

artefacts.role: SII base types: Cabecera/Titular, Contraparte, FacturaExpedidaType, FacturaRecibidaType, DetalleIVA.
SII envelope. Declares 17 top-level record families; only FacturasEmitidas and FacturasRecibidas are invoice families. Registro* collections carry maxOccurs=10000.
VERI*FACTU base types: RegistroFacturacionAltaType, RegistroFacturacionAnulacionType, SistemaInformaticoType, DesgloseType.

VERI*FACTU envelope. RegistroFactura is a CHOICE of RegistroAlta | RegistroAnulacion repeated to maxOccurs=1000, so one submission may mix registrations and cancellations and must be classified per record, never per file.
